summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary existing fleet growth. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, authorize no launch, outreach, monetization expansion, telemetry change, credentials, spending, or production work. Preserve only already-approved bounded work that introduces no new data collection or monetization-sensitive behavior. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics but not redistribution rights; current public terms restrict commercial/public collection, derivatives, display, and pricing use. Compliance baseline reports 37 passes, 16 fails, and 6 unknowns across 59 sites. Telemetry incompleteness alone is not a growth blocker, but site-specific compliance failures block launch or monetization for affected sites until evidenced resolved.

SearchWoot launch-readiness tracking remains active with 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. No task is closed because the required evidence is not present. Current blockers are authoritative source rights, documented data flow and retention, GA4 consent/configuration evidence, and vendor/log/incident handling. The next evidence action is to produce one read-only evidence bundle from the repository and deployed configuration covering source fields, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification delivery, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor terms, and incident/request procedures. Keep the private gate unchanged pending the owner's concrete choice: prepare an unsent permission request, keep private with no outreach, or end the public-beta pursuit.

Data-use dispositions: Woot deal and price-history data is blocked because current terms do not establish rights for storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising. Smallest next action: obtain a current written provider permission or agreement specifying permitted fields, retention, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; missing inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: document the deployed alert data flow and retention/deletion controls. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal capture, property and data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction review. Smallest next action: capture read-only consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce the operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Human counsel is required before any public beta involving Woot data, affiliate monetization, advertising, historical price derivatives, public product imagery or trademark use, or jurisdiction-specific personal-data processing. The site terms, privacy page, cookie policy, and technical compliance scan are evidence of implementation posture only; they do not establish upstream data rights or constitute legal certification. Affiliate disclosures, claims about price or savings, copyright/trademark provenance, platform-policy compliance, and any regulated or age-sensitive use require site-specific evidence before expansion.

Ordinary bounded SEO/content work may continue conditionally under existing owners and measurement gates when it preserves site boundaries, uses no new personal-data collection, adds no monetization-sensitive behavior, and passes quality, smoke, rollback, and measurement checks. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as proof of noncompliance or as a reason to block routine growth. Do not make revenue, margin, ROI, CAC, payback, forecast, or causal-lift claims; the supplied Amazon evidence supports only $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21, with site-level attribution unsupported.
